description:
Email an invoice to its customer via QuickBooks Online.

Example: { "invoiceId": "123" }
Example: { "invoiceId": "123", "sendTo": "billing@example.com" }

WORKFLOW:
1. Use list_quickbooks_invoices to find the invoice ID
2. Send to the invoice's billing email, or override with sendTo

Note: this emails a real customer.

sendTo.description: Override recipient email (default: the invoice billing email)

name: send_quickbooks_invoice_email
